title: Estrada graft case: Witness signed PDAF vouchers to avoid losing job

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A witness in the graft case of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada testified on Thursday that she was compelled to sign disbursement vouchers for the release of the lawmaker’s pork barrel funds out of fear that refusing to do so would affect her employment. Speaking before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division, Sofia Cruz said she signed the disbursement vouchers for the release of Estrada’s Priority Development Assistance Funds (PDAF) when she was the chief financial specialist of the National Livelihood Development Corp. (NLDC). The NLDC was a state-owned company used as a conduit to funnel lawmakers’ pork barrel funds into foundations owned by […]...
